title: Artifact fingerprinting, pin-synthesis and micro-canary harness for new open LLM intake
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build an end-to-end acceptance flow for open-source LLM weights that (1) produces deterministic artifact fingerprints and provenance metadata, (2) synthesizes a versioned pin manifest (v2) with runtime compatibility hints, and (3) runs a lightweight micro-canary smoke harness to publish a performance profile. This ticket scopes the conversion/validation orchestration, pin manifest schema extension, and the micro-canary runner plus telemetry gating for profile publish.
acceptance_criteria: Ingested weight bundles receive a reproducible SHA256 fingerprint and a signed provenance blob stored with the artifact registry
Pin manifest v2 generated automatically for each accepted artifact containing: model_version, conversion_path, quantization_compat_matrix, runtime_kernels_hint, and canonical_sequence_samples

Micro-canary runner executes 10 targeted inference traces across CPU/GPU variants within the ingest pipeline and emits per-trace latency, p95, token-throughput, and a checksum of outputs for regression detection
Performance profile published to the catalog only after telemetry gating passes (no regressions vs. baseline and SLO thresholds met)
End-to-end flow covered by e2e smoke tests and a follow-up GH action to prevent regressions to the conversion step
notes: Design decision: favor deterministic conversion (bit-for-bit stable) over permissive acceptance to make pins reproducible across rebuilds. Trade-off is additional conversion time and stricter rejection of variable ops during conversion.
We will extend the existing pin schema to v2 rather than mutating v1. v2 will include runtime hints and quantization compatibility map to drive smart routing and fallback at serving time.

Telemetry gating will use synthetic prompts (canonical_sequence_samples) and a small tracked prompt set owned by Eval team. If regression > 3% for quality or > 20% for latency p95, the artifact is flagged for manual review.
Plan to keep micro-canary runner small (max 30sec per artifact) to avoid blocking bulk ingestion. Full profiling jobs remain a separate async pipeline.
Will leverage existing artifact registry and signing keys (KMS) from runtime-ops. Need to confirm HSM integration timeline for final signing step.

2026-03-05 - Infra blocker: conversion container occasionally OOMs when running quantization pipeline on 40B models. Reproduced on staging; assigned to ENG-77244 for container memory tuning.
2026-03-08 - PR reviews: ingest/pull/1287 requested changes on error handling and retry backoff. Added suggested idempotency keys for replays.
2026-03-10 - Evaluation team provided canonical prompt set (12 prompts) and baseline metrics for 3 representative open models. Integrated baseline into micro-canary harness.
2026-03-12 - Telemetry gating rule drafted: require no >3% QA regression on prompt set AND p95 latency within 125% of baseline. Will iterate after first 100 onboards.
2026-03-12 - Next steps: stabilize conversion container, finalize signing flow with Security, add GH action for e2e smoke, and schedule a canary-with-certificates run for 2026-03-20.
